# Lauren Fine, MD

> Lauren Fine, MD, FAAAAI is a board-certified allergist and immunologist, medical educator, TEDx speaker and life coach based in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. Her practice, Lauren Fine Coaching, works with capable people who are doing too much and need a place to think it through, in medicine and outside it, whether that means staying, scaling back, or making a change. Her line: think it through, leave with your next step. Coaching is virtual across the US and internationally, with in-person sessions by appointment in the Fort Lauderdale area. The first 55-minute session is free.

Lauren is Associate Professor and Assistant Dean of Clinical Skills Education at Nova Southeastern University Dr. Kiran C. Patel College of Allopathic Medicine, Harvard Macy Institute faculty, and the founder of ReasonDx (https://reasondx.com), a clinical reasoning education platform. Her TEDx talk is "Permission to Change: Finding Your Ikigai."

Coaching packages: Clarity Sprint $1,400 (four 55-minute sessions over 4 to 6 weeks), Change Navigation $2,600 (eight 55-minute sessions over 3 months), Full Transformation $3,600 (twelve 55-minute sessions over 6 months).
